Name: Shemaiah, Son of Shechaniah
Summary: Son of Shechaniah and father of Hattush, Igeal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 3:22: Son of Shechaniah and father of Hattush, Igeal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Shemaiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
